Every October, Punjab's paddy fields burn. Farmers have about two weeks between the rice harvest and sowing wheat, and clearing the straw by machine costs them two and a half to four thousand rupees an acre. Burning costs almost nothing. So the smoke rolls over North India.
Parali Setu takes that whole job off the farmer. We clear the field for free before sowing, pay for the straw the same day, and sell it to power and biogas plants all year.
A farmer just talks, in Punjabi, Hindi or English, with no language to choose. Our assistant, built on Gemini, asks only for what's missing: acres, village, sowing date, name and number.
Then it makes an offer: today's price for the district, the payout, and a pickup slot before the sowing date. The farmer says yes, in their own words, and the booking is made.

Here is the rule that keeps it honest. Gemini only talks. Every price, weight and date comes from our optimizers, and code checks every number in every reply. In testing, across a hundred and eighty replies, it did not make up a single number.

Before any crew leaves, a person calls the farmer to confirm. Our routing model, built with Google OR-Tools, fits every farm into a crew's day, and hires on-call crews only when ours are full. Against simple dispatching rules, it drove up to thirteen percent less.
To be ready for the rush, we forecast when each district harvests. Twenty-five seasons of NASA fire data in BigQuery, forecast with Google's TimesFM, placed last year's peak within a week.
And after we collect a field, Earth Engine compares satellite photos from before and after. A burn scar stays for weeks, so it can catch burning that fire alerts miss.
Companies order a year of straw in one sentence, and see what we can supply each month.

It all runs on Google Cloud: Gemini on Vertex AI for the conversation, Text-to-Speech and Speech-to-Text for voice, Cloud Run for the app and optimizers, Firestore, BigQuery, Earth Engine, Maps and Firebase Hosting.

We measured it. Forty test farmers, forty bookings, every detail recorded correctly, ten out of ten trick conversations handled, and Google's own AI grader scored our answers point nine six for sticking to the facts.
Every field we clear is straw that isn't burned. Parali Setu: don't burn it, book a pickup.
